overview_description.description: Scientific and Medical Equipment House offers technological solutions and services for healthcare and catering projects. The company handles the maintenance and repair of medical equipment and undertakes general contracting for buildings, roads, and bridges. It also provides facility maintenance and cleaning services, supporting the operational needs of healthcare infrastructure.
